request: 버튼부를 뚜렷하게 추가하고 양옆 게이지를 더 크게 만든다.
notes: 게이지 채움 표시는 정지 시안의 예시이며 게임 동작을 결정하지 않는다.

variants.title: 버튼부·게이지 확대
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the attached original game-frame artwork. This image is the edit target. Produce ONE complete updated frame, same portrait 2:3 canvas, straight-on front view, entire frame visible, charcoal background. The user asks for TWO clearly visible improvements: a real prominent button section at the bottom, and MUCH LARGER gauges on BOTH side pillars.

KEEP: the two large overlapping silver armor shells and diagonal gold interlock on each pillar, the overall restrained silver/slate-blue/blue-black/gold 2D mechanical design, four equal dark lanes and three subtle dividers, open top with no bridge, the existing overall scale and symmetry. Keep the central lane opening width. Make the following physical design changes large enough to be immediately obvious beside the source.

1. ADD A CLEAR ROW OF FOUR LARGE PRESSABLE BUTTONS ABOVE THE FOUR EXHAUST OUTLETS.
Currently the four tiny dark strips above the circular outlets do not read as buttons. Replace those strips with FOUR substantial distinct raised keycaps, one per lane. Each button has a large uninterrupted dark blue/slate rectangular pressing face, modestly chamfered corners, a thin silver rim, a visible front bevel and a narrow dark travel gap separating it from the stationary chassis. The visible face should be approximately as wide as its lane and about 70-90 image pixels high at a 1024x1536 output, around three times the current cap's visible height. Clearly readable as mechanical input buttons at thumbnail size, like a substantial arcade-rhythm input deck. Exactly one button per lane, no split faces, no labels. The pressing faces incline gently upward so the front-on camera can see their full faces. Make the keycap silhouettes distinct from the fixed silver side armor. Keep all four keycaps the same design and size.
Organize the lower assembly into TWO clear compact tiers: large button faces on top, four smaller fixed front-facing exhaust apertures below. Reduce the oversized round exhaust surrounds to create space for the button deck. Each aperture belongs directly beneath its own button. Preserve exactly ONE continuous aperture per input, no twin bores or secondary glowing dots. The first and fourth apertures are unlit, the second pale cyan and the third warm gold. Both active exhausts have identical geometry and a single restrained bright core/forward-facing glow directed toward the viewer, never downward. The round exhaust is an outlet, not the button. Do not add a fifth button, extra controls or central badge. Integrate the deck with the existing angular lower corner shells and shared dark beam.

2. MAKE BOTH SIDE GAUGES LONG, WIDE, FUNCTIONAL-LOOKING GAUGE WINDOWS.
The source only has a narrow short blue light strip in the upper portion. Replace each with ONE continuous long recessed rectangular gauge along the pillar's straight inner edge. Each gauge extends from near the top of the lane to just above the new button deck, covering roughly 85% of the tall playfield height. Make the visible gauge window around THREE TIMES the width of the source strip, approximately 30-40 pixels wide at 1024 output. These must be prominent readable gauges, not decorative thin edge LEDs.
Show each as a deep dark vertical track with a broad pale-cyan fill rising from the bottom to about 70% height, and a clearly visible unlit dark upper remainder. The filled-to-empty boundary is sharp and horizontal. This fill level is just a static visual example. Add a sparse set of small quiet tick notches on the metal rim, no numbers or text. Left and right tracks match in scale and sample fill. The entire gauge window, including its dark remainder, should be visibly continuous. Keep glow controlled; do not bloom into the lanes. Move or trim armor locally to accommodate these wider gauges without narrowing the playable central rectangle, while preserving the defining diagonal overlapping armor OUTSIDE the gauges.

Keep artwork crisp and polished: broad cel-shaded metal faces, precise bevel highlights, dark matte skeleton, selective reflected light. Preserve a coherent manufactured assembly. No photo texture, weathering, grain, extra glowing accents, characters, text, logos, arrows, callouts, extra views or comparison sheet. This is the same frame with a conspicuous button deck and much larger side gauges.
